confirmed_findings.rule: Relevance and sediment [craft] — a line loses relevance by going stale as the behaviour it describes changes; without a pruning discipline this becomes sediment.
confirmed_findings.target_quote: The banked `swapgate5-probe-doctrine-v2` currently *does* report DRIFTED, because a dotfiles input moved after the run.
confirmed_findings.issue: This asserts the live, present-tense status of one specific banked run as a fact in a document meant to persist across time. Once that run is re-banked or the drifted input is fixed, this sentence (and the matching "-> DRIFTED (exit 1)" line in the Verified output block above) becomes false, misleading a future reader who sees a passing verify and assumes the doc or the tool is broken.
confirmed_findings.proposed_fix: State the mechanism generically instead of asserting a specific run's current status, e.g. "verify reports DRIFTED whenever an input recorded in a run's manifest (such as a dotfile) changes after the run was banked — this is expected, not a bug." Drop the named-run claim, or mark it explicitly as a point-in-time example that may no longer hold.
